description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Arachchige Rajika Lalitha Kodithuwakku as a member of the Sri Jayawardhanapura Kotte Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a municipal council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new elected member by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely within the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for government bodies.
